bangla_explanation: Assessment tool দুই ভাগে: instrument আর procedures।
Instrument হলো নির্দিষ্ট questions বা activity, যা assessment method থেকে তৈরি।
Procedures হলো instructions: কোন অবস্থায় assessment হবে আর কীভাবে রেকর্ড রাখা হবে।
নতুন tool বানানোর আগে existing tools দেখুন, এতে time আর money বাঁচে।

example.en: For a driving test, the instrument is the list of tasks. The procedures tell the candidate the test conditions.
example.bn: ড্রাইভিং টেস্টে কাজের তালিকা হলো instrument, আর নিয়মকানুন হলো procedures।

list_answer.title: Parts of an assessment tool

items.text: Instrument: the specific questions or activity developed from the assessment method.

cites.quote: the specific questions or activity developed from the selected assessment method/s

items.text: Procedures: instructions on conditions for conducting and recording the assessment.

cites.quote: procedures - the information/instructions given to the participant and/or the assessor regarding conditions under which the assessment should be conducted and recorded

items_bn: Instrument মানে আসল প্রশ্ন বা activity, যা বেছে নেওয়া assessment method থেকে তৈরি হয়।

short.prompt: What is an assessment instrument? Name three assessment instruments that you may use.
short.modelAnswer:
An assessment instrument is the specific questions or activity developed from the selected assessment method. It may also include a profile of acceptable performance and decision making rules.
Three assessment instruments:
1. Observation checklist
2. Oral questioning tool
3. Third party report
